description.value: Marble Slab Creamery is a Canadian ice cream franchise that mixes custom flavours and toppings on a frozen granite slab in-store, with over 50 flavours including vegan options and handrolled waffle cones. The Fort St. John location sits along 96 Street and offers ice cream cakes and pre-packed take-home options in addition to fresh scoops. It's a handy sweet stop for cyclists moving through the Peace Region of northeastern BC.

address.value: Unit 104 - 9317 96 Street, Fort St. John, BC V1J 6V5
